explanations.1: IfModule checks if Apache has the mod_rewrite module installed; the code inside only runs if it does.
explanations.7: This condition checks if HTTPS is not already enabled (!=on means 'not equal to on').
explanations.8: [L,R=301] means 'L' stops processing further rules, and 'R=301' sends a permanent redirect response to the browser.
explanations.12: !^www\. means 'if the domain does NOT start with www.' — the backslash escapes the dot so it matches a literal period.
explanations.13: This rule redirects to www with https, but only if the previous HTTPS redirect already happened (due to the [L] flag above).
